'''Matthew Mitler''' is an American actor and voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of ''[[Pokémon the Series]]''.

== Pokémon roles ==
Mitler initially voiced a few characters on {{aniseries|PTS}} from [[S01|the first season]] to [[S03|the third season]]. He briefly returned during [[S09|the ninth season]] to voice [[Keenan]] and [[Kerrigan]], but has not voiced any characters since.
